label: Village of Alburgh
header: # Village of Alburgh -- sweep decisions applied 2026-10-22; issue #163 (VT master tracking).

sources.note: Village of Alburgh, official homepage (live): under 'Village Delinquent Collector' the village lists Cheryl Dunn. The charter office is titled Collector (24 App. V.S.A. ch. 203 sec. 301(a)); the homepage label is the same office in practice, per Walter's ruling, 2026-10-22, on the sweep report's decision items. Dunn's existing person record (Alburgh town scope -- she is the town lister and the village clerk and treasurer) is reused.
Village of Alburgh charter, 24 App. V.S.A. ch. 203, sec. 301(a): the Collector is among the village officers elected at the annual meeting.
